API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIAdmin and Role ManagementAdd Admin User
Add Admin User
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/adminUsers

Creates an admin user.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
associateWithExistingAdmin
boolean

Indicates whether to associate this admin with an existing admin.

Default value: false
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
id
int32

Admin's user ID.

loginName
string

Admin's login name. The login name is in email format and uses the domain name associated with the Zscaler account or the SSO domain defined in SAML.

userName
string

Admin user's "friendly" name, e.g., "FirstName LastName"

email
string

Admin user's email address.

role
object
comments
string

Comments for this admin user.

adminScopescopeGroupMemberEntities
object[]
adminScopeType
string

The admin scope type. An admin's scope can be limited to certain resources, policies, or reports. An admin's scope can be limited by LOCATION, LOCATION GROUP, or DEPARTMENT. If this is not specified, then the admin has an ORGANIZATION scope by default. The attribute name is subject to change.

Possible values: [ORGANIZATION, DEPARTMENT, LOCATION, LOCATION_GROUP]

adminScopeScopeEntities
object[]
isDefaultAdmin
boolean

Indicates whether this is a default admin.

disabled
boolean

Indicates whether this admin is disabled.

isDeprecatedDefaultAdmin
boolean

Indicates whether this admin is deletable. If true, this admin is read-only and not deletable.

isAuditor
boolean

Indicates whether the user is an auditor. This attribute is subject to change.

password
string

The admin's password. If admin single sign-on (SSO) is disabled, then this field is mandatory for POST requests. This information is not provided in a GET response.

isPasswordLoginAllowed
boolean

The default is true when SAML Authentication is disabled. When SAML Authentication is enabled, this can be set to false in order to force the admin to login via SSO only.

isSecurityReportCommEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether communication for Security Report is enabled.

isServiceUpdateCommEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether communication setting for Service Update is enabled.

isProductUpdateCommEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether communication setting for Product Update is enabled.

pwdLastModifiedTime
int64

Last time admin password was modified.

isPasswordExpired
boolean

Indicates whether an admin's password has expired.

isExecMobileAppEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether Executive Insights App access is enabled for the admin.

sendMobileAppInvite
boolean

Indicates whether to send an invitation email to download Executive Insights App to admin.

execMobileAppTokens
object[]
newLocationCreateAllowed
boolean

Indicates whether user is allowed to create a new location.

sendZdxOnboardInvite
boolean

Indicates whether to send an invitation email for ZDX onboarding to admin.

name
string

Admin user's "friendly" name, e.g., "FirstName LastName" (this field typically matches userName.)

Responses
​
200
400
401
403

OK

Schema
Example (auto)
